content_sections.heading: KSHD Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: Two separate notifications have been issued for horticulture posts. The general notification covers 80 posts across the state, while a separate notification covers 5 Assistant Horticulture Director posts reserved for candidates from the Kalyana-Karnataka region under Article 371(J). Total posts under this notification: 80. The department has clarified that post-wise and category-wise details are provisional and subject to revision as per government orders issued from time to time. These 5 posts are reserved for candidates belonging to the Kalyana-Karnataka (Hyderabad-Karnataka) region under the local candidate reservation rules applicable to that region.

content_sections.heading: KSHD Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: As per Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977, candidates must be at least 18 years old as on the last date for submission of applications. As per Government Order No. CSaU 262 SEN 2025 dated 29.01.2026, the upper age limit has been relaxed by 5 years for this recruitment cycle, taking the limits below into account. Additional age relaxations of up to 10 years are available for widows, ex-servicemen, government employees, and certain other specified categories as per the notification. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

rows.educational_qualification: Must be a Graduate in Horticulture from a University established by law in India and accredited by the Indian Council of Agriculture Research (ICAR).
Must hold a Post Graduate Degree in Horticulture along with a B.Sc. in Horticulture from a University established by law in India and accredited by ICAR.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are there in KSHD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 80 posts under the general notification (75 Assistant Horticulture Officer and 5 Assistant Horticulture Director) and an additional 5 Assistant Horticulture Director posts under the separate Kalyana-Karnataka notification.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KSHD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 30.08.2026, and fee payment must be completed by 31.08.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Horticulture Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in Horticulture from a University recognized by law in India and accredited by ICAR.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Horticulture Director?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate degree in Horticulture along with a B.Sc. in Horticulture from a University recognized by law in India and accredited by ICAR.

faq.answer: Yes, 0.75 marks are deducted for each wrong answer.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum qualifying mark in the competitive examination?
faq.answer: Candidates must secure at least 35% marks to qualify in the competitive examination.
